envelope.description: Add the single-item vault with validation and a mutation queue

body.title: Add the single-item vault with validation and a mutation queue
body.summary: Back getKey, setKey, deleteKey and listKeys with one Keychain item under service insrc-vault: single-flight load with a five-minute memory of a failed load, runtime validation of names and values, whole-payload validation on load and before every write, one mutation queue writing the Keychain first and memory after, retirement on delete, and a test-only backend setter below the vault.
acceptanceChecks: Concurrent reads perform one Keychain read
A refused load fails at once for five minutes and then retries
An invalid stored payload fails closed and is never rewritten
A malformed name or value leaves memory and the stored item unchanged
A name such as __proto__ is an ordinary key
A failed write leaves memory unchanged and concurrent saves lose no update
A deleted name is recorded as retired
A retired name saved again is readable

tests.name: vault: concurrent reads perform one Keychain read
vault: a refused load fails at once for five minutes and then retries
vault: a payload with a bad version, missing secrets, a non-string value or a bad retired list fails closed and is never rewritten
vault: a malformed name or value leaves memory and the stored item unchanged
vault: a name such as __proto__ is stored and read as an ordinary key
vault: a failed write leaves memory unchanged
vault: concurrent saves lose no update
vault: a deleted name is recorded as retired
vault: a retired name saved again is readable
